aisc-v16.title: AISC Shapes Database v16.0 (sheet 'Database v16.0', U.S. customary columns converted to mm)
aisc-v16.terms: AISC Readme sheet (August 2023): 'consistent with shape properties and dimensions tabulated in the AISC Steel Construction Manual, 16th Edition, 1st Printing'; it carries a disclaimer of warranties and no licence terms. The official page (aisc.org) sits behind a browser challenge, so the file was taken from two public mirrors whose data agree (only four EDI names differ). Only defining dimensions, nominal weight and area are taken; every property is recomputed.
aisc-v16.columns: AISC_Manual_Label, d (or Ht, OD), bf (or B), tw, tf (or t, tnom, tdes), kdes, W, A. r1 = kdes - tf (design fillet, derived); no toe radii; S, C and ST flanges at the standard 2:12 (16.67 %) slope, MC flanges as parallel; HSS corners ro = 2 t, ri = t (AISC Manual Part 1)
